templates.name: Template 2
templates.description: Black-and-white photo cards on textured grey/black, yellow dashed-arrow scribbles, yellow accent word — 3 content slides.

canva.coverRole: the curly-quoted quote text box inside the yellow box in the lower-left of the cover page (page 1) — currently reads “Have Life”, curly quotes included. Every other text box on page 1 (the large white 'ONE FOR THE WEEK' headline, the small 'Bishop Said' label above the yellow box and 'Scroll to be blessed' below it) is a fixed label — never change those.

slideRoles.headline: the white headline word (bold condensed font, ALL CAPS) — on page 2 it sits top-left on the black area; on page 3 it sits at the top of the rounded black-and-white photo card on the left; on page 4 it sits at the top-left inside the wide rounded photo card
slideRoles.highlight: the large yellow accent word (tall condensed font, ALL CAPS) directly below the white headline on pages 2 and 3, and to the lower-right of it inside the same photo card on page 4
slideRoles.paragraph: the small body paragraph text block (displayed in caps by the font) — on page 2 it is lower-left on the textured grey area (green text); on page 3 it is lower-right on the black area (white text); on page 4 it is near the top on the textured grey area above the photo card (green text)

canva.numberNote: Each content page already has a small yellow numbered circle badge (1-3) in the upper-right matching its page order, plus the church logo and yellow/green dashed-arrow scribbles — leave all of those untouched.

templates.name: Template 3
templates.description: Bold split-page layout, teal dashed-arrow scribble accent, two-tone headline + gradient highlight word — 2 content slides.

canva.coverRole: the quote text box sitting inside the teal dashed-arrow scribble near the bottom-left of the cover page (page 1) — styled like a short curly-quoted phrase (e.g. “Do not forget”). Every other text box on page 1 (the small ‘Bishop Said’ label, ‘Scroll to be blessed’, the large ‘ONE FOR THE WEEK’ headline, and the vertical REACH / RAISE / RELEASE / REPRODUCE tagline running down the left edge) is fixed — never change those.

slideRoles.headline: the two-line stacked headline text box at the top-left of the page (bold font, wraps over two short lines)
slideRoles.highlight: the larger gradient accent-colored word directly below the headline, same position, bold font
slideRoles.paragraph: the body paragraph text block positioned below the headline/highlight, on the white side of the page

canva.numberNote: Each content page already has a small colored numbered circle badge (1, 2) in the top-right corner, matching page order — leave those untouched.

templates.name: Template 4
templates.description: Green crowd-photo halves on textured off-white, white + yellow condensed headlines, yellow number badges — 4 content slides.

canva.coverRole: the curly-quoted quote text box inside the small yellow box near the bottom-left of the cover page (page 1) — currently reads “Carry stones”, curly quotes included. Every other text box on page 1 (the large green 'ONE FOR THE WEEK' headline, the small 'Bishop Said' label above the yellow box and 'Scroll to be blessed' below it) is a fixed label — never change those.

slideRoles.headline: the white headline text box (tall condensed bold font, ALL CAPS, may wrap over 1-2 short lines like 'Not a' or 'Carry your') sitting on the dark green crowd-photo half of the page — on pages 2 and 5 that half is at the top, on pages 3 and 4 it is at the bottom
slideRoles.highlight: the large yellow accent word directly below the white headline, in the same dark green photo half (even larger condensed font, ALL CAPS)
slideRoles.paragraph: the green body paragraph text block on the light textured off-white half of the page (displayed in caps by the font) — below the photo half on pages 2 and 5, above it on pages 3 and 4

canva.numberNote: Each content page already has a small yellow numbered circle badge (1-4) on the right side matching its page order, plus the church logo top-left and a hand-drawn arrow — leave all of those untouched.

templates.name: Template 1
templates.description: Green split backgrounds, yellow accents, bold condensed headlines — 2 content slides.

canva.coverRole: the one large quote text box sitting in the yellow-highlighted panel near the bottom of the cover page (page 1) — styled like “Example quote”, curly quotes included. Every other text box on page 1 (the small 'Bishop Said' label, 'Scroll to be blessed', and 'one for the week') is a fixed label — never change those.

slideRoles.headline: the large white headline text box near the top-left of the page (very large bold font)
slideRoles.highlight: the large yellow/accent-colored highlight text box directly below the headline (even larger font, ALL CAPS)
slideRoles.paragraph: the smaller body-colored paragraph text box positioned above the headline/highlight panel

canva.numberNote: Each content page already has a small numbered circle (1, 2) in the top-right matching its page order — leave those untouched.

templates.hiddenReason: Canva design belongs to the old Canva account; the connected Canva can't open it. Replace designId with a copy made in the new account, then remove 'hidden'.
